_what: C-STRUCT J1 stance-set successor. CSTRUCT-priority-reorder-J1-FRESH-2STANCE-SOURCE-N20에서 정확히 한 configuration lever만 바꾼다: STANCE_SET. 두 가지 연속 가능한 첫 질문을 오경보 비용과 지연 비용 중 어느 쪽을 더 크게 보는지 드러내는 행동 지향으로 교체한다. PRIORITY_LIST 문구와 세 arm의 permutation, timeline, empty BLOCKS, gate, K1, base는 byte-identical하다. 새 stance set은 새 baseline을 요구하므로 이 suite는 baseline N10 calibration부터 시작하며 이전 N20 표본을 합치지 않는다.

_authoring_provenance.owner: 윤석 · 2026-07-30 read-mechanism-run 진단 후 stance-set 수정 승인, Codex가 calibration probe로 구조화
_authoring_provenance.program_status: pre-negative-control · provisional. program-wide negative control이 clean이 되기 전에는 공식 evidence나 verdict로 승격하지 않는다.
_authoring_provenance.single_changed_lever: STANCE_SET only. Priority content/order, arm permutations, gate, timeline, empty BLOCKS, K1, base, model and output schema are unchanged.

rejected_configuration.distribution: baseline b14/a6, live b12/a8, placebo b11/a9
rejected_configuration.diagnosis: 출처 질문과 위험 질문은 둘 다 짧고 가역적인 정보 수집이며 어느 쪽도 A/B 중 하나를 포기하게 만들지 않았다. K1의 fear reading도 arm별 6/20, 3/20, 1/20으로 흔들렸고 모든 fear-reading call이 b를 골랐다. 질문 행동을 그대로 이름 붙인 labels는 A12의 behavior-orientation shape도 충족하지 못했다.

_authoring_provenance.stance_set_rebuilt: Behavior orientations with cost-bearing glosses. a는 오경보 비용, b는 지연 비용을 더 크게 보는 방향이다. '누구에게 무엇을 묻는다'는 완성 행동을 제거해 두 해석이 같은 정보수집 stance로 탈출하지 못하게 한다.
_authoring_provenance.temperament_vocabulary_check: A12 lint target. K1의 load-bearing vocabulary인 절차 · 신원 확인 · 프로토콜 고지 · 위협 · 겁에 질린 · 안정 · 말을 자르지 않고 · 말을 이어갈 수 있게 · 표준 대응을 사용하지 않는다. 검증 · 오경보 · 시민 · 선제 · 지연 · 피해는 K1에 없다.
_authoring_provenance.sample_status: Calibration only. Run baseline N10 first, then size an independent comparison suite from that distribution. Do not pool the predecessor N20 or this calibration baseline into a later p-value.
_authoring_provenance.a8_status: The timeline is unchanged. It supplies a scripted-call cue but does not rank false-alarm cost against delay cost.
_authoring_provenance.a10_status: The base [무게] remains unranked: it names both unnecessary evacuation and delayed evacuation. The rebuilt stances force the model to reveal which cost it weights more heavily without adding a base ranking.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At the fresh J1 first-call gate under K1 on template v0.4, after replacing completed first-question descriptions with mutually exclusive cost-bearing behavior orientations, moving actual-danger delay goal B above source-grounding goal A shifts the stance distribution toward 선제 (b), while reordering only reporting principles C/D leaves the placebo distribution near baseline.
pre_registration.drop_condition: Run baseline only as calibration. If baseline already selects the predicted live stance b >=8/10, drop this configuration under A14 rather than spending live/placebo calls. Otherwise preserve the baseline distribution, compute attainable exact outcomes, and author an independent comparison suite with a newly pre-registered N; do not reuse these calibration calls in its p-values.
contingencies: The predecessor N20 and this calibration baseline are separate samples and are never pooled.

If baseline selects both a and b, inspect whether the reasons actually distinguish false-alarm cost from delay cost before sizing the comparison. A mixed tally without reason separation is not useful headroom.
If the same utterance form routinely appears under both orientations, record a B3b player-visible legibility problem even if the stance distribution later separates.

If b is still selected by treating more hazard detail as source verification rather than accepting delay cost, the new labels did not remove the escape path. The next lever is the gate/stance consequence, not stronger priority prose.
Code K1's explicit fear reading separately. If fear reading still determines b regardless of priority order, record temperament dominance rather than attributing movement to C-STRUCT.
If a later comparison has discard rates differing by more than 15 percentage points, stop it as arm-incomparable under the runbook hard stop.

The output schema has no structured priority-id citation. Priority use is coded manually from inner_note and rejected_reason. Fabricated because_block_ids in these empty-block arms remain A5 compliance data, not C-STRUCT trace evidence.
pre_registration.not_claimed: This is a baseline calibration for one stance-set rewrite, not C-STRUCT evidence. It does not test live/placebo attribution, priority depth, returning-run survival, C-BLOCK interaction, in-situ deltas, player discoverability, or official program validity before the negative control.
